SessionStart.command: if [ -n "${SPAWN_SUBAGENT_AGY_RUN:-}" ]; then exec "$HOME/.local/bin/spawn-subagent" _agy-hook session-start; fi; cat >/dev/null; echo '{}'

hooks.command: if [ -n "${SPAWN_SUBAGENT_AGY_RUN:-}" ]; then exec "$HOME/.local/bin/spawn-subagent" _agy-hook pre-tool; fi; cat >/dev/null; echo '{"decision":"allow"}'

Stop.command: if [ -n "${SPAWN_SUBAGENT_AGY_RUN:-}" ]; then exec "$HOME/.local/bin/spawn-subagent" _agy-hook stop; fi; cat >/dev/null; echo '{}'
